You can view the full list of supported currencies directly in the app by navigating to the 'Exchange' or 'Accounts' section. Please let us know if you have a specific currency in mind and we would be happy to check if it is supported.

I am sorry to hear that you lost your wallet. For your security, please lock your card immediately through our mobile app or online banking portal. Once you have done that, you can report the card as lost and request a replacement directly in the app, or by calling the 24/7 customer support number on our website so an agent can verify your identity and assist you.

If you are waiting for a new card to arrive, you can check its estimated delivery date in the 'Cards' section of our mobile app. Note that standard postal deliveries often do not include live tracking. If you have misplaced an active card, please freeze it immediately in the app and let us know so we can help you order a replacement.

Thank you for reaching out. Eligibility for opening an account depends on the applicant's age and our current account policies. Please check our website's FAQ section or Terms and Conditions for specific minimum age requirements and information on whether junior or custodial accounts are available.

To open a standard bank account independently, you generally need to be at least 18 years old. We also offer youth and teen account options that can be opened with a parent or legal guardian as a co-owner. Please review our account terms online or visit a local branch for the specific requirements of each account type.

To link an existing card to your account, please open the mobile app, navigate to the 'Cards' section, and select the option to link an existing card. You will just need to follow the on-screen prompts and enter your card details. If you run into any issues, please contact our support team through the app for assistance.

You can view your PIN securely within our mobile banking app. Please log in, navigate to the 'Cards' section, select the card you wish to view, and tap on 'View PIN'. You may be asked to verify your identity using your app passcode or biometrics.

If your PIN has been blocked after too many incorrect attempts, you can usually unblock it right inside our mobile banking app under the 'Card Management' or 'Security' section. If you aren't able to unblock it through the app, please reach out to our customer support team so we can verify your identity and assist you further.

You can typically unblock your PIN directly through our mobile banking app under the 'Card Management' or 'Security' settings. If that option is unavailable, you can also try unblocking it at a supported ATM or by contacting our customer support team for further assistance.

You can check and manage your contactless payment settings directly in our mobile app. Simply log in, navigate to the 'Cards' section, select your card, and tap on 'Security Settings' to ensure contactless payments are enabled. Please note that if your card is new, you may need to complete one chip-and-PIN transaction first to activate the contactless feature.

I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with contactless payments. If this is a new card, please ensure you have completed one Chip and PIN transaction first to activate the contactless feature. Also, for security reasons, you may occasionally need to enter your PIN after several contactless uses. Please check our mobile app to ensure contactless is enabled in your card settings, and if the issue persists, let us know so we can look into issuing a replacement card.

I am sorry to hear your contactless feature isn't working. If this is a new card, you will need to complete one chip-and-PIN transaction first to activate contactless payments. Additionally, for security reasons, we occasionally require you to insert your card and enter your PIN after a certain number of contactless uses. Please also check your mobile banking app to ensure contactless isn't disabled in your settings. If the issue persists after a chip-and-PIN transaction, your card's antenna may be damaged, and you can request a replacement card directly through the app.

We are glad you found your card! If you simply froze the card temporarily, you can easily unfreeze and re-link it directly within the Cards section of our mobile app. However, if you previously reported the card as permanently lost or stolen, it cannot be reactivated for security reasons, and you will need to wait for your replacement card to arrive.

I'm sorry to hear that your contactless feature isn't working. If this is a new card, please ensure you have completed at least one Chip and PIN transaction first to activate the contactless function. Also, you may occasionally be asked to enter your PIN for security purposes once you reach a certain spending limit. If you have already tried using Chip and PIN and contactless still isn't working, please let us know through the in-app chat so we can check your card settings or arrange a replacement if the card is damaged.

To use contactless payments, simply tap your card against a payment terminal that displays the contactless symbol. Please note that you will need to complete at least one transaction using your chip and PIN first to activate the contactless feature. Additionally, payments over a certain amount may occasionally require your PIN for security purposes.
Yes, for security reasons, you will need to complete at least one chip and PIN transaction (or use an ATM) before the contactless feature on your new card will be activated.

We generally do not charge a fee for receiving money into your account. However, depending on the transfer method or currency, the sender's bank or an intermediary bank may apply their own fees. Please check the fee schedule in your app for specific details regarding your account type.

Depending on whether your card was temporarily frozen or permanently canceled, you may be able to reactivate it directly in our mobile app under the 'Cards' section. If the card was permanently canceled for your security, it cannot be reactivated, and you will need to wait for your replacement card to arrive.

We understand it is frustrating to wait for your funds. While card top-ups are typically instant, they can occasionally remain pending due to routine security checks or processing delays from your card issuer. Please allow up to 24 hours for the transaction to complete. If it is still pending after that time, please reach out to us with the transaction details so we can investigate further.

I apologize for the delay with your top-up. Sometimes card transactions remain pending due to standard security checks or processing delays from the card issuer. These usually resolve within a few hours, though it can occasionally take up to a few business days. If the funds have not been credited after 24 hours, please reach out to us with the transaction details so we can investigate further.

We understand it can be frustrating to wait for a top-up to clear. Processing times vary depending on the payment method used, with bank transfers sometimes taking up to three business days. Please let us know how and when you initiated the top-up so we can look into its current status for you.

A 'pending' status means that your top-up has been initiated and is currently being processed. Depending on the payment method used, it can take anywhere from a few minutes to a few business days for the funds to clear and appear in your available balance. If the transaction remains pending for longer than the standard processing time for your chosen method, please contact us again so we can look into it for you.

You can view your current top-up limits and learn how to increase them directly in the app. Please go to your account settings or profile section, where you may be asked to complete additional identity verification to qualify for higher limits.

We use the real-time interbank exchange rate for currency conversions on weekdays, with a small markup applied on weekends. You can view our live rates for any supported currency at any time directly within the mobile app.

I am sorry to hear your transaction did not go through. Transactions can fail due to insufficient funds, incorrect recipient details, or automated security blocks. Please check your app notifications for a specific error message, or share the date and amount of the transaction with our support team so we can look into this for you.

Thank you for reaching out. While many domestic transfers arrive within a few hours, they can sometimes take up to one full business day to process, or up to five business days for international transfers, depending on the recipient's bank and standard security checks. Please allow a bit more time for the funds to appear. If the transfer does not arrive after the standard processing window, please contact us again so we can assist you further.

We accept major US debit and credit cards, such as Visa and Mastercard, for account top-ups and payments. Please check the app for a full list of supported card networks and any applicable fees for using an international card.

We support a wide range of local and international fiat currencies for holding, exchanging, and spending. You can view the complete list of supported currencies directly in our mobile app or on our website's help center. Please note that we do not currently support direct deposits or transfers of cryptocurrencies.

A virtual card is a digital-only payment card accessible through our mobile app. It functions like a standard debit card for online shopping and can also be added to digital wallets like Apple Pay or Google Pay. For added security, its card details are separate from your physical card, and you can freeze or delete it at any time in the app.

You can view and manage your virtual cards by logging into our mobile app or online banking portal and navigating to the 'Cards' section. If you do not see an option for virtual cards there, please let us know so we can check your account eligibility.
Your card is accepted at any merchant or ATM worldwide that displays the network logo (Visa or Mastercard) shown on the front of your card.

Your card can be used at most merchants and ATMs worldwide that accept our payment network (such as Visa or Mastercard). However, please note that certain countries or specific merchant categories may be restricted for security and regulatory reasons.
